values.note: 2026 dates: primitive camping (first-come, pit toilets, limited services) from May 8, full service May 22 to October 12, primitive again to October 24. ReserveAmerica shows 2027 reservations starting May 28.

season.source: NH State Parks campground operating schedule 10-2026 ('Dry River | Central | 5/8 | 5/22 | 10/12 | 10/24' = Primitive Begins, Full Time, Fall Primitive, Last Reservable Date); park page ('Open 5/23, Closes 10/24'); RA ('Primitive Camping Season Oct 12, 2026 to Oct 24, 2026 ... pit toilets will be open'; 'Status: Closed through Thu May 27 2027')

note: Wooded sites in Crawford Notch on US-302, with the Dry River beyond the loop. Thirteen standard sites take 30-40 ft (3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11-13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 23); the others take 20 ft or less. Supplies at the Willey House snack bar 3 miles west; little or no cell service. --Claude
summary: Park page + 3/2026 map + RA per-site catalog: 36 sites, 13 standard sites take 30-40 ft, no hookups, $35, flush toilets/showers/water, 2026 season 05-08 (primitive; full service 05-22 to 10-12) to 10-24, RA 2027 from May 28, four sites first-come. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone should be the campground's 603-374-0848.
flags: PHONE: 603-374-2272 (map: 'Park Manager Office') -> 603-374-0848 (park page 'Dry River Campground: 603-374-0848'). Either is official; the campground line is the better one.

Rig fit: 13 of 18 standard sites take 30-40 ft (RA Max Vehicle Length); 5 standard sites 20 ft; pop-up/tent sites 15 ft.
